comment: The SRC_GPU branch now focuses on CUDA as the only experimental GPU backend.
projectionBackend=cuda remains an explicit failure in full SRC/MPCD runs.
CUDA CG on an existing EllipticOperatorPlan is added and validated against CPU reference CG.
Plan topology and coefficients are uploaded once per standalone solve.
phi,r,p,Ap remain on device during the CG loop.
Block reductions are finalized on host for pAp and residual norms; acceptable for validation, not final performance design.
Wire CUDA CG into project_face_field for a restricted Q6 path after standalone validation.
